name: web-ai-meeting-assistant-floating-glass-ui-layers-over-laptop
title: Indigo project cover with a dark laptop, floating glass calendar layers and an app icon, under giant 'Meeting Assistant'
whatItIs: A blue-violet gradient with a giant white 'Meeting Assistant' title, a dark laptop on a plinth showing a greeting and date cards, translucent floating UI layers with calendar entries at the right, a glowing app icon at the top right and a small Website Design pill.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and layered; floating glass panes explain the interface depth.
techniques: Float translucent UI layers around a laptop.
Set giant title text behind the device.
Use an indigo gradient with glow.

vocabulary.definition: A UI pane hovering separately from the screen.
Large text partly hidden by a device.
An app icon with a luminous edge.
